name: Copenhagen Major 2025
description: The pinnacle of Counter-Strike competition. 24 elite teams battle through the Swiss system in Legends, Challengers, and Contenders stages. Features $1.25M prize pool, exclusive weapon stickers, and the iconic Major trophy. Teams qualify through Regional Major Rankings (RMRs). The path to glory spans 5 intense weeks of best-of-3 elimination matches.

name: Shanghai Major 2025
description: CS2's second Major of the year, hosted in China for the first time ever. 24 teams compete for the $1.25M prize pool and prestigious Major trophy. Features the iconic Swiss system format with Legends, Challengers, and Contenders stages. A historic moment for Asian Counter-Strike.

name: IEM Katowice 2025
description: The legendary Spodek Arena hosts the world's most prestigious non-Major event. 16 elite teams compete in a double-elimination group stage followed by single-elimination playoffs. The roaring Polish crowd creates an unmatched atmosphere. Top 20 ranked teams receive direct invites; 4 spots awarded via closed qualifiers.

name: IEM Cologne 2025
description: Known as 'The Cathedral of Counter-Strike', IEM Cologne is ESL's flagship summer event. 16 top teams battle in the iconic LANXESS Arena. Double-elimination groups into single-elimination playoffs. Best-of-3 matches throughout, with a best-of-5 Grand Final. The most prestigious trophy outside of Majors.

name: BLAST World Final 2025
description: The ultimate culmination of the BLAST Premier circuit. Only the top 8 teams in circuit standings qualify for this season-ending championship. Single-elimination bracket with all matches best-of-3, Grand Final best-of-5. $1M prize pool and the most exclusive trophy in the BLAST ecosystem.

name: ESL Pro League Season 21 Finals
description: The premier global league competition. 24 S-Tier teams compete over 6 weeks in a round-robin format with Conference groups. Top teams from each group advance to the playoff bracket. All league matches are best-of-1; playoffs are best-of-3. Qualification requires S-Tier league standing.

name: IEM Dallas 2025
description: North America's premier IEM event. 16 teams compete in a double-elimination group stage followed by single-elimination playoffs. Features a mix of top international teams and NA hopefuls. Top 30 ranked teams are eligible for invites; remaining spots via regional qualifiers.

name: IEM Chengdu 2025
description: IEM returns to China with a stacked 16-team lineup. Double-elimination groups into single-elimination playoffs. Strong emphasis on Asian representation with additional slots for regional teams. A key stepping stone for Asian teams looking to prove themselves on the international stage.

name: BLAST Premier Spring Finals
description: Spring culmination of the BLAST Premier circuit. 8 top teams compete in a single-elimination bracket. All matches best-of-3 with best-of-5 Grand Final. Circuit points are awarded for World Final qualification. Only top 16 ranked teams are eligible for invite consideration.

name: BLAST Premier Fall Finals
description: Fall culmination of the BLAST Premier circuit. 8 elite teams battle in a single-elimination bracket. Critical for World Final qualification as teams make their final push for circuit points. High-stakes matches with best-of-3 format throughout, best-of-5 Grand Final.

name: ESL Challenger League Season 48
description: The proving grounds for emerging European talent. 16 A-Tier league teams compete in a round-robin format over 6 weeks. Top finishers earn promotion to ESL Pro League. All matches are best-of-1 during league phase, with best-of-3 playoffs. The gateway to tier-1 competition.

name: BetBoom Dacha Belgrade
description: High-stakes tournament in the heart of Serbia. 8 invited teams compete in a single-elimination bracket. Known for its intimate LAN setting and passionate crowd. Features best-of-3 matches with best-of-5 Grand Final. A fan-favorite event with excellent production value.

name: Thunderpick World Championship
description: One of the largest B-tier events with a massive $500K prize pool. 16 teams compete in a full double-elimination bracket. 8 direct invites plus 8 qualifier spots. Features both established names and rising stars. All matches best-of-3, Grand Final best-of-5 with bracket reset.

name: Betway Masters 2025
description: European tournament showcasing rising talent and established mid-tier teams. 12 teams compete: 4 direct invites and 8 qualifier winners. Single-elimination bracket with best-of-3 matches. A key opportunity for B-tier teams to earn recognition and prize money.

name: YaLLa Compass 2025
description: Premier tournament for Middle East & North Africa. 8 invited teams compete in a single-elimination bracket. Strong focus on MENA representation with additional slots for regional teams. Best-of-3 throughout with best-of-5 Grand Final. A celebration of MENA esports.

name: Elisa Masters Espoo 2025
description: Finland's premiere esports event. 8 teams compete in a single-elimination bracket in the Metro Areena. Known for its intimate Nordic atmosphere and passionate Finnish fans. Best-of-3 semi-finals and best-of-5 Grand Final. A highlight of the Nordic CS scene.

name: Perfect World Arena Premier League
description: Asia's premier league competition, operated by Perfect World. 12 teams compete over 3 weeks in round-robin groups. Top teams advance to playoffs. Features dedicated slots for Chinese, Korean, and SEA teams. A critical pathway for Asian teams to gain international experience.

name: WePlay Academy League
description: Development league for academy and young teams. 16 teams compete in a round-robin format over 8 weeks. Open to any team, making it ideal for rising talent. Features coaching support and broadcast exposure. The ultimate proving ground for tomorrow's stars.

name: CCT Online Finals 2025
description: Champions Cup Tour culmination event. 16 teams who qualified through CCT events compete in a single-elimination bracket. All matches best-of-3 with best-of-5 Grand Final. A celebration of grassroots competitive CS with solid production and prize pool.

name: ESEA Premier Season 48
description: North America's premier grassroots competitive league for mid-tier teams. 20 B-Tier league teams compete over 12 weeks in a round-robin format. Matches are best-of-1 during regular season. Top 8 advance to playoffs with best-of-3 matches. The pathway from amateur to professional NA CS.

name: Skyesports Championship 2025
description: South Asia's premier championship. 8 teams who qualify through open brackets compete in a single-elimination playoff. Strong focus on Indian subcontinent representation. Best-of-3 throughout with best-of-5 Grand Final. The biggest event in South Asian Counter-Strike.

name: Gamers8 Riyadh 2025
description: Saudi Arabia's flagship gaming festival featuring 8 invited teams. Single-elimination bracket with LAN finals in Riyadh. Features world-class production and hospitality. Best-of-3 semi-finals and best-of-5 Grand Final. A showcase event for MENA esports ambitions.

name: Roobet Cup 2025
description: Season-ending invitational showcase. 8 teams compete in a single-elimination bracket. Features a mix of top-tier teams and fan favorites. Known for entertainment value and unique format variations. Best-of-3 throughout with best-of-5 Grand Final.

name: Copenhagen Major EU RMR
description: European Regional Major Ranking event. 16 teams compete in Swiss format for slots at the Copenhagen Major. Teams earn RMR points based on placement. Top finishers qualify directly; others enter the Challengers or Contenders stage. The gateway to Major glory for EU teams.

name: Copenhagen Major Americas RMR
description: Americas Regional Major Ranking event. 16 teams from NA and SA compete in Swiss format. Top finishers earn direct qualification to the Copenhagen Major. Critical for American teams to secure their Major slots. Intense competition across the Americas region.

name: Copenhagen Major Asia RMR
description: Asia Regional Major Ranking event. 8 teams compete in Swiss format for Major slots. Features teams from China, Korea, SEA, and Oceania. The primary pathway for Asian teams to reach the Major stage. Limited slots make every match crucial.

name: IEM Katowice EU Closed Qualifier
description: Closed qualifier for IEM Katowice. 8 teams who survived open qualifiers compete in a double-elimination bracket. Top 2 finishers earn spots at IEM Katowice main event. High-stakes matches where careers can be made or broken.

name: IEM Katowice Open Qualifier
description: Open qualifier - anyone can enter! 32 teams compete in a single-elimination bracket. Top finishers advance to closed qualifiers. No ranking or league standing required. The purest form of competitive meritocracy in Counter-Strike.

name: Thunderpick Open Qualifier
description: Open qualifier for Thunderpick World Championship. 32 teams compete in a single-elimination bracket. Top 8 finishers advance to the closed qualifier. Open to all teams regardless of ranking.

name: Thunderpick Closed Qualifier
description: Closed qualifier for Thunderpick World Championship. 16 teams compete: 8 from open qualifier + 8 invited based on ranking. Top 8 advance to main event.

name: IEM Cologne Open Qualifier
description: Open qualifier for IEM Cologne. 32 teams compete in single-elimination. Top 8 advance to closed qualifier.

name: IEM Cologne Closed Qualifier
description: Closed qualifier for IEM Cologne. Top 2 finishers earn main event spots.

name: Shanghai Major EU RMR
description: European Regional Major Ranking for Shanghai Major. 16 teams compete in Swiss format.

name: Shanghai Major Americas RMR
description: Americas Regional Major Ranking for Shanghai Major.

name: Shanghai Major Asia RMR
description: Asia Regional Major Ranking for Shanghai Major.

name: BLAST Premier Spring Showdown
description: Spring qualifying event for BLAST Premier Finals. 12 teams compete for circuit points.

name: BLAST Premier Fall Showdown
description: Fall qualifying event for BLAST Premier Finals. Critical for World Final qualification.

name: ESL Pro League Conference
description: Conference stage of ESL Pro League. 16 teams compete for playoff spots.

name: IEM Rio 2025
description: South America's premier IEM event. Known for its passionate crowd.

name: DreamHack Open Summer
description: Classic grassroots LAN tournament. Open to all teams.
